headline: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a) | Inpatient & Acute Care
summary: Registered Nurse with over 3 years of experience in hospital inpatient settings across the Lisbon metropolitan area. Solid practical background in medical-surgical wards, patient monitoring, and medication management. Experienced in documenting care plans via SClínico and collaborating with multidisciplinary medical teams to ensure safe and steady patient recovery.

experience.title: Registered Nurse - Medical-Surgical Inpatient Ward
bullets: Deliver direct nursing care to an average of 7 to 9 inpatient beds per shift in a 32-bed medical-surgical unit.
Prepare and administer intravenous, oral, and subcutaneous medications, maintaining daily clinical records in the SClínico electronic health system.
Perform post-operative wound care, surgical drain management, and vital signs monitoring, escalating acute changes to the medical team.
Participated in a ward initiative to update patient fall-prevention checklists, which helped reduce minor inpatient falls by 12% over six months.

experience.title: General Care Nurse - Internal Medicine Ward
bullets: Provided acute inpatient nursing care for adult patients admitted with respiratory, metabolic, and cardiovascular conditions.
Executed venipunctures, urinary catheterizations, and nasogastric tube placements according to hospital infection control protocols.
Assisted patients and families with discharge preparation and home medication guidance.
Maintained accurate shift handovers and nursing notes using SClínico.
